verdict_scope: Independent static review of all 23 changed files and the authorized 58 actual limited native regression tests. This is not a claim that the integrator full gate set has passed or mainline acceptance has completed.

findings.summary: Standalone installer now links the runtime zlib SONAME declared by its prerequisites.
Runtime receipt now records and hashes the directly listed canonical ELF loader.

source_review: Single 23.1.4 pin controls generated Rust version constants, LLVM link major, native runtime guards, test expectations and receipts.
Raw FFI declarations, ownership, target configuration, pass pipeline and object cache protocol remain unchanged.
No text-parser fallback or expanded unsafe exception was added.
Dependency policy records the upstream change; language design and Cargo.lock remain byte-identical to baseline.
Installer uses hash-verified official static PIC inputs and explicitly reports the locally relinked DSO and host runtime dependencies.
Checker enforces exact LLVM/Clang/LLD/Rust identities and structured failures; CI keeps existing product gates and adds migration checks.
Migration runner keeps actual source/native exit-code, cache-isolation and version-refusal controls distinct from synthetic runner tests.
Negative controls and failure logs are retained rather than replaced by later Pass receipts.
earlier_negative_control_scope: Three actual refusal checks were run at 27a, not rerun at 48f. The only follow-up edits are the later link argument and dependency enumeration; checksum refusal and existing-prefix refusal paths are untouched, and the checker is byte-identical. These are retained supporting evidence, not newly counted candidate test executions.
